vulnerability_mechanism.evidence: lookup() forwards req.method to find(); acf1283552c1e0fc5e5939dc1f23f195fadd3676 stores method roots in a normal object and reads this.trees[method]. Inherited keys such as constructor are truthy, bypass the missing-root return, and are treated as nodes until currentNode.prefix.length throws. The live CVE record is PUBLISHED and the live GHSA is not withdrawn.

atomic_bic.evidence: acf1283552c1e0fc5e5939dc1f23f195fadd3676 is the smallest public first-write: its diff introduces both this.trees = {} and find()'s this.trees[method] lookup. Later rewrites retain the same sink and are not introducers.

immediate_parent_absence.evidence: The BIC's verified immediate parent is 57e7a6d6f1bb26ac3239bbfd839c81311e3dd9a4. That parent has no this.trees reference; it initializes this.tree as a Node and find() traverses this.tree, so the vulnerable method-to-plain-object lookup is absent.

squash_member_decomposition.evidence: GitHub PR #168 exposes exactly two members: benchmark-only 57e7a6d6f1bb26ac3239bbfd839c81311e3dd9a4 and BIC acf1283552c1e0fc5e5939dc1f23f195fadd3676. The latter's tree 75bd52aba7c0a1cfae6d7e2d4a8bb7fe87f09d72 equals squash landing b9337ca6c437b6491922602e00596b8b488ad8f6's tree, so the squash itself is not substituted for the atomic BIC.

affected_release_membership.evidence: v3.0.4 resolves to ce6d38b8a9430048934ddadb74a33950e7344101 and still uses this.tree; b9337ca6c437b6491922602e00596b8b488ad8f6 is an ancestor of v3.0.5 and v9.6.0. The v9.6.0 source still initializes this.trees with {} and performs this.trees[method].

fixed_release_membership.evidence: cfe3fd6168b5ac1594c0820fb83fce251a533fc1 is not an ancestor of v9.6.0 and is an ancestor of v9.7.0. The v9.7.0 source uses Object.create(null) at both initialization sites, matching the live GHSA's first patched version 9.7.0.

direct_fix_or_verified_unpatched_state.evidence: Direct fix cfe3fd6168b5ac1594c0820fb83fce251a533fc1 changes constructor and reset() from {} to Object.create(null) and adds constructor-method lookup/find and HTTP/2 regression tests. Its parent a21e332f69c82684cdd130b79164236ef7c15684 remains vulnerable. Advisory-linked PR #434 is closed, unmerged, and unrelated to this fix.

bic_only_ai_attribution.evidence: The BIC object and live GitHub commit record identify Harry Brundage as author and committer, carry a valid GPG verification, and contain no AI/co-author/generated-with trailer or AI marker. Attribution was evaluated on acf1283552c1e0fc5e5939dc1f23f195fadd3676 only, not on the GitHub-committed squash or the 2026 fix.

findings: Independent replay confirms the primary causal chain, atomic BIC, NOT_AI verdict, and direct fix without a field-level correction.
The CVE description's final sentence says 9.0.7, but its affected data says < 9.7.0 and the GHSA, Git tags, ancestry, and patched source all establish 9.7.0 as the fixed release.
